title: GIS-Based Monitoring of Grape Moth (Lobesia botrana) at Quinta da Senhora da Graca, Douro Demarcated Region, Portugal
description: A GIS practical exercise applying terrain analysis, mating-disruption planning, delta-trap placement, and spatial capture-damage assessment across three flight periods for the grape moth Lobesia botrana at a 42.97-hectare vineyard estate in the Douro Demarcated Region, Portugal.
